title: Shell Fantasy No.2
text: This is one of my earlier oil paintings, following a more creative approach while still using the sea and its creatures for inspiration.
alt: Oil painting of a large white spiral shell swept up in swirling blue water, with fish, seaweed, a starfish and small shells below.

title: Balancing Rocks Zimbabwe
text: These very famous balancing rocks in the south of Zimbabwe are typical of the granite rock formations in the south of the country, where I grew up. It was done in a nostalgic mood many years after leaving the country.
alt: Ink and watercolour painting of balancing granite rocks in southern Zimbabwe, stacked above dry grass, with a hazy landscape behind.

title: Path Down to the Sea
text: This painting is mainly from imagination and extensive memories . I wanted to convey a sense of huge space with light clouds , an unthreatening, lazy sea and the sandy beach below the footpath  invitingly close.
alt: Oil painting of a sandy path through dune grass leading down to a beach, with waves breaking under a blue sky and light clouds.

title: Design in Inks - Brown
text: A design with a shell, in ink, wax and water. One of a series I did exploring the effects of the different mediums.
alt: Ink and wax design in rust-orange and cream, built around a large shell surrounded by rippling bands and rays.

title: Still life with Cinque Port pottery
text: The Cinque Port Pottery formed a basis for this still life. I liked the free blue design, and with more blue in the cloth, rich brown eggs in a brown bowl make a good contrast.
alt: Oil still life of brown eggs in a dark red bowl beside a blue-and-white patterned jug and cup, on a striped cloth.

title: Design with White Lilies
medium: Ink, pastel and watercolour on paper
text: This began as a study of white lilies, but my love of design moved the interest on to the shape behind the lilies, and then a shape was created within that shape. Apart from ink and watercolour, I used pastel over the top of the background, throwing the central image forward.
alt: Ink and watercolour design of white lilies set inside layered, wavy green outlines on a dark background.

title: Three Heads design in Ink
text: Three heads in a design which includes hands, flowers and movement. All detail imagined or remembered.
alt: Ink drawing in black and grey of three faces among flowing hair, hands and flowers.

title: My Beautiful Blue Hat
text: This is a hat which I have had for years, shown off to perfection by a young friend!
alt: Oil portrait of a smiling young woman with long fair hair, under a wide-brimmed, textured blue hat.

title: The Spotty Bowl
text: I bought this little spotty bowl at an exhibition and enjoyed the challenge of painting its roundness. The flowers and cloth are a good background.
alt: Oil still life of a small, round, spotted bowl lying beside white daisies on a blue checked cloth.

title: Black Sea Urchin
alt: Black and white ink drawing of a sea urchin shell, its surface patterned with rows of circles.

title: Pathways by the Sea
place: Pathway on the dunes above Leasowe Beach Wirral
text: A pathway along the open stretch of land above the beach, leading invitingly into the horizon and beyond.
alt: Oil painting of a straight path through golden grassland on the dunes above Leasowe Beach, Wirral, under a blue sky with large white clouds.

title: Abandoned Shed
text: I came across this abandoned shed while walking along a path in Co Mayo, Ireland. I loved the way the original stone structure had survived the bitter winter weather for many years, long past its original use.
alt: Oil painting of a small stone shed beside a snow-covered track in Co Mayo, Ireland, with fir trees behind.

title: Shell Design in Brown and Pink
text: This is a favourite of mine, as I like the colours and feel that the design element between the shells has resulted in a compact, interesting and beautiful little painting.
alt: Oil painting of shells in pinks, creams and browns, arranged as a design of fanned and spiralling shapes.

title: Zantedeschia
text: I grew this plant without realizing just how unusual the flowers were. I painted them here in various stages of opening.
alt: Watercolour of arum lilies (Zantedeschia), with white flowers, deep purple centres and spotted green leaves, at several stages of opening.

title: Pink Peonies
text: I grew those beautiful flowers and often painted them, although this is the only one in oil. I became interested in creating a background which adds depth to the painting.
alt: Oil painting of pink peonies in full bloom, with buds and leaves, against a dark background.

title: Brown Bearded Iris Study
text: Of the many different irises I grew, these brown ones were the most difficult to paint, as the spots of brown seem endless!
alt: Watercolour of brown bearded irises with spotted, ruffled petals, buds and long leaves, on white paper.

title: Beach in Kerry, Ireland
text: The windswept beach, with the misty land across the bay, inspired me to paint the contrast between the cool colours of the land and the vibrancy of seaweed and dead grass on the beach.
alt: Oil painting of a beach in Kerry, Ireland, with dune grass and seaweed in the foreground and misty hills across the bay.

title: Pink Peonies
text: One of several watercolour studies I did of these beautiful flowers, which were growing in my garden.
alt: Watercolour of bright pink peonies with yellow centres, buds and green leaves, on white paper.

title: Figure by waterfall
text: A figure by a waterfall, bending across towards her leg. She is hollow in design, linking in with the designs and shapes around her.
alt: Black and white ink and wash drawing of a hollow, stylised figure crouching beside a waterfall.

title: Moon, Sea and Shells
text: This painting started as a study of a broken shell but developed, as so many of my paintings do, into a composition of shells, seaweed and moonlight, creating patterns and shapes in and around the central area.
alt: Oil painting in blues of a broken shell, seaweed and scattered small shells, with moonlight radiating from behind.

title: Old Gateway Winchester
text: An old gateway in Winchester, where old buildings add to the attractions of this city. It was done in ink with a watercolour wash of paint.
alt: Ink and watercolour painting of an old stone archway in Winchester, framing a garden and a red-brick building beyond.

title: Bluebells in Spring
text: A swathe of blue flowers across the woodland, where two birch trees stand out against the darker wood.
alt: Oil painting of bluebells spreading across a woodland floor beneath tall silver birch trees.

title: Pale Mauve Bearded Irises
text: These large flowers are beautiful in their colouring and complexity. They were painted from life and are life-sized.
alt: Watercolour of two pale mauve and white bearded iris flowers with ruffled petals, on white paper.

title: Light in the Snow
text: This is an entirely invented landscape. I was interested in how a bright light shining through trees and off snow would look in the dark.
alt: Oil painting of bright light shining through dark tree trunks onto snow.

title: Sunlight on Red Sandstone Wall
text: The effect of the sun on old sandstone walls caught my interest during a walk near West Kirby. I loved the way the path seemed to lead towards the sun, the brightness there emphasizing the bright redness of the old walls.
alt: Oil painting of a sunlit path through green woodland near West Kirby, running beside an old red sandstone wall.

title: Old Graveyard in Didling
text: This old graveyard surrounds a very old church in West Sussex, often called the Shepherd's Church. It has a peaceful, gentle atmosphere, as it is far from the noise and rush of the modern world and has been there for centuries.
alt: Watercolour of old gravestones in a quiet churchyard at Didling, West Sussex, under a large tree, with a wooden gate behind.

title: Autumn Fruits
text: I love the variety of seeds and leaf colour one gets in autumn, and have done several arrangements with conkers and chestnuts. This one was painted in watercolour, with again attention to detail.
alt: Watercolour of autumn fruits: chestnuts in spiky husks, acorns and blackberries on oak leaves.

title: Three Heads
text: These heads are entirely from imagination and come from a time when I was exploring faces in different mediums with creative backgrounds.
alt: Pencil drawing of three faces framed by flowing, patterned shapes and flowers.

title: Two Magenta and Pink Bearded Irises
text: Two more of the large bearded irises in my garden. They were painted from life and are life-size.
alt: Watercolour of two bearded irises with pale pink upper petals and magenta lower petals, with buds, on white paper.

title: The Pink Moon
text: This is a vision of a garden, starting with the iris, the moon, then the shape of a statue pouring water. The images repeat at points around the painting.
alt: Watercolour design in blue-greys with a large pink moon, purple irises, winding water and garden shapes.

title: Pink Fish and Shell
text: Shells and fishes swirled around with seaweed. Colour is restricted to concentrate the eye on the composition.
alt: Watercolour of pink-tinged fish and shells swirling with seaweed in a blue-grey sea.

title: Waiting
text: Five figures stand, waiting, as the huge sea surges close to them.
alt: Watercolour of a huge surging wave, with a small group of figures standing on the shore in the distance.

title: The Chess Game
text: The strong colour and shape of the lily and its vase dominate the foreground, while in the background four women talk while a breeze moves the curtain.
alt: Ink and watercolour painting of a pink lily in a teal vase beside chess pieces on a chequered board, with four women talking behind a curtain.

title: Twisting Wave
text: I was interested in the way water moves, twisting and rushing on, taking all before it. This is an early painting exploring this interest, which I have returned to over the years, increasingly in oils.
alt: Watercolour of a green and white wave twisting into a spiral, with shells and fish caught in it.

title: Out of a Book
text: A figure stands on a beach, her clothing forming the shape of a ship's prow; behind her, figures seem to appear from out of the book's pages.
alt: Watercolour of a pale figure on a beach, her flowing robe shaped like a ship's prow, beside yellow lilies and figures emerging from the pages of an old book.

title: Figure from the Sea
text: I was interested in the link between shell structures and bone structures, with all life beginning in the sea.
alt: Watercolour in lilac and grey of a curled figure surrounded by flowing shell-like and bone-like forms and fish.

title: Floating Shell
text: I have drawn this shell several times. This was the beginning of the idea of floating shells, culminating in my oil painting of 2024.
alt: Watercolour of a large ridged shell floating among pale clouds and pink fish.

title: Still Life with Grapes and Bottle
alt: Oil still life of a red wine bottle, green grapes, bread, cheese and a wooden plate on a white cloth, with canvases behind.

title: Blue Jug and Orange
text: This blue jug belonged to a friend and I admired it for some time before borrowing it to paint! The crisp white tablecloth shows up the colour and the shape of the jug. The orange and orange dish are essential in this combination.
alt: Oil still life of a blue jug with a leaf pattern, an orange and a bowl on a white lace-edged cloth.

title: Stylised Still Life
text: This started as a composition of bottles, which then became the interesting structure it is now.
alt: Stylised oil still life of a green bottle, a white jug, daisies, and grapes with vine leaves, set against a gold frame.

title: The Yellow Bush
text: This painting is based on trees seen on a walk in the woods in Cheshire, where one bush in particular stood out.
alt: Oil painting of a bush of bright yellow leaves between two silver birch trees in a Cheshire wood.

title: Near the Austrian Border
text: I was able to visit the area around the Austrian/German border in 2000, and subsequently used photos I took at the time to paint this landscape.
alt: Oil painting of green alpine valleys and mountains near the Austrian-German border, with a small farmhouse in the meadow.

title: Young Woman in Brown Hat
alt: Watercolour portrait of a young woman with auburn hair in a brown hat, against pale daisies.

title: Pastel of Young Girl Painting
alt: Pastel of a girl seen from above, lying on a blue floor and painting, surrounded by paint boxes and finished pictures.

title: Portrait in ink and pastel
alt: Ink and pastel portrait of a red-haired young woman in a black cap and dark scarf.

title: Caught in the sun
alt: Oil portrait of a smiling woman with red hair and a dark green jumper, warmly lit from one side.

title: A Path in the Wirral
place: Near the Wirral Way, West Kirby
text: This is a path near the Wirral Way, near West Kirby, when it was still very natural and overgrown.
alt: Oil painting of a sunlit path between overgrown green banks and trees near West Kirby, on the Wirral.

title: Ruined Building in Snow
text: Somewhere along a path in Co Mayo, Ireland, where this long-abandoned building stands out in the snow.
alt: Oil painting of a ruined stone building above snow-covered fields in Co Mayo, Ireland, with a fence and bare trees.

title: Landscape with Birch Trees
text: Landscape with birch trees in Hampshire, England. Again, the interest here is the white of the tree bark against the green background of trees and fields.
alt: Oil painting of silver birch trees framing a view of green fields in Hampshire.

title: Against the sea wall
text: Seagulls whirling in and out of the currents of air thrown up by the power of the sea against the rocky land.
alt: Oil painting of seagulls wheeling above huge waves crashing against dark cliffs.

title: Composition with Argonaut Shell
text: This began as a detailed study of this amazing shell and developed into a shell caught by a curving wave onto a beach.
alt: Oil painting of an argonaut shell merging into a curling blue wave, with pebbles on the sand below and a starry night sky.

title: White Shell Skeleton
text: The idea of fish bones and skeletons of creatures was the beginning for this painting. I wanted to retain a feeling of spiky fish bones, as well as movement of the sea and the shore against which the shells and bones will be tossed.
alt: Oil painting of a pale, spiky shell skeleton curling in a swirl of blue-green water.

title: Floating Shell
text: I first painted this shell many years ago as a watercolour, and then recently painted it again as a large, strong shell which floats effortlessly above the landscape. It creates a feeling of peace, with the unthreatening skyline far off.
alt: Oil painting of a large ribbed white shell floating above a seashore, with breaking waves and a distant horizon.

title: Green Landscape with Road
text: A quiet country road in spring, with sunlight softly lighting the way ahead.
alt: Oil painting of a quiet country road winding through spring woodland in soft sunlight.

title: Two Dogs in the Pea Fields
Sea Urchins - Imaginative Composition
text: I have several sea urchin shells and find their complex patterns endlessly fascinating. This painting captures the magic of the shell as well as the power of the water around it.
alt: Oil painting of two sea urchin shells cradled in a curling blue-green wave.

title: 1-5 Series of Ink and brush Heads
alt: Two ink and wash studies in sepia of women's heads: one with curly hair and earrings in profile, one in a headscarf looking down.

title: Seascape
text: I do not use acrylic usually, but decided to as an experiment, as I wanted to convey several levels in this painting: the sea itself, powerful against the unsettling sky; secondly, the outlines of the large shells across the picture; and thirdly, the beach moving strongly from left to right of the painting. I am happy with the result.
alt: Acrylic and ink painting of large white shell outlines across a turquoise sea and sandy beach, under a blue sky.

title: Five Birch Trees with Pool of Water
text: Five birch trees stand in soft sunshine, their trunks mirrored in the still pool between them. There is no wind and the whole scene is quiet and calm. Largely imagined.
alt: Oil painting of five silver birch trees reflected in a still pool in a green meadow.

title: A View of the Hampshire Downs
text: A typical view of the Hampshire Downs, seen through trees growing along the roadway. Based on a photograph.
alt: Oil painting of a view of the Hampshire Downs, seen through a line of tall trees beside a road.

title: Birch Trees in Spring with Dandelions
Three Shells
alt: Watercolour of three shells: a sea urchin, a dark brown spiral shell and a pink shell with a toothed opening.

title: Landscape with Red Roofs
text: A summer landscape, with a path passing between trees inviting the viewer to look out towards the houses in the distance.
alt: Oil painting of a path between tall trees leading towards green fields and red-roofed houses in the distance.

title: Thurstaston Beach at Sunset
text: Thurstaston beach at sunset, with a small stream meandering across the pebbles and sand towards the sea.
alt: Oil painting of Thurstaston beach at sunset, with a small stream winding across the sand towards the sea.

title: Portrait of Dot Cato
alt: Oil portrait of an older person with silver hair, in a blue jumper and white collar, looking down.

title: Shell Skeleton
text: This painting started with a broken shell, which developed into a shell on a beach, and then finally into a part of the original shell reflected in the water of the beach in which it is trapped.
alt: Oil painting of part of a broken shell reflected in water inside a swirling blue wave, with small shells on the sand.

title: Autumn Woods
text: Autumn woods with a variety of trees shedding their leaves. The deep orange of one in particular enhances the colours of the others. A calm, quiet day.
alt: Oil painting of autumn woodland with tall trees in orange, yellow and green on a calm day.

title: Sepia figure
alt: Ink drawing in deep red and black of a stylised female nude, framed by flowing abstract shapes.

title: Shells and Seaweed
alt: Ink and wax design in black, white and pink of curling shell and seaweed shapes.

title: Abalone shell on beach
text: I am happy with this painting of an abalone shell on a beach. Far in the distance the line of the sea has a calming effect, while the merging of reality with imagination has resulted in a calm yet interesting painting.
alt: Oil painting of an abalone shell lying on a pale beach, casting long blue shadows, with the sea far in the distance.

title: Tumbling Shells
text: Shells swept by the waves, with the tension caused by the deep sea pulling the shells ever downwards.
alt: Oil painting of shells being swept along in curving bands of blue and white water.

title: Tossed by the sea
text: Fish, shells and seaweed tossed by the waves. One of the first paintings in which the idea of the sea and beach were linked.
alt: Watercolour of fish, shells and seaweed tossed by a breaking wave onto a beach, in blues, lilacs and white.

title: West Kirby reedbeds
place: Between West Kirby and Hoylake, looking towards Hilbre
alt: Oil painting of dune grass and reedbeds between West Kirby and Hoylake, looking across the shore towards Hilbre, under a blue sky with clouds.

title: The Garden
text: The idea of all that makes a garden special is here to some extent: roses, water, vegetation, insect life and endless design!
alt: Watercolour design in greys, black and red, combining roses and rosebuds, falling water, leaves and a large veined insect wing.

title: Shells with magenta wash
text: A detailed study of shells, highlighted by a clear bright wash of magenta colour.
alt: Watercolour of a starfish and spiky shells on a bright magenta wash.

title: Shell study in brown and blue
text: I loved the detail on the main shell and contrasted it with the blue of the sea from where it had come.
alt: Watercolour of a large spiky shell with ridged brown and cream detail, against a deep blue sea.

title: Composition: two shells
text: I am happy with this painting, as I like the way the two very different shells come together to form a whole while at the same time retaining their individual characteristics. The small shells balance the whole.
alt: Oil painting in blue-greens of two contrasting shells merging into one swirling form, with a starfish and small shells below.

title: Sunrise on surface of the sea
text: This was painted in acrylic paints, and painted quite quickly as I tried to capture the effect of sunlight catching the moving water. It relied to a large extent on imagination and memory!
alt: Acrylic painting of the sun rising over rolling green-grey waves.

title: Looking through a shell
text: Looking through the broken shell as it is tossed by the wave, along with fishes and shells, through to the calm beach in the background.
alt: Watercolour of a broken pink shell tossed by a wave with fish and shells, with a calm beach seen through it.

title: Argonaut shell study
text: I was given this shell as a gift and love its fragility and incredible patterning. I wanted to convey both this fragility as well as its resilience against the powerful swirl of the ocean.
alt: Oil painting of a white argonaut shell against a swirling deep blue background.

title: The figure in the sea
alt: Watercolour in magenta and white of a faint figure emerging from swirling water.

title: Heather near Liphook, Hants
text: This was painted when the heather was at its best. Looking up from the lower part of the path, the trees seemed to tower above the beautiful swathe of colour in the clear light.
alt: Oil painting of purple heather beneath tall trees near Liphook, Hampshire, in clear light.

title: Winchester Cathedral
alt: Ink and watercolour painting of Winchester Cathedral seen through the stone arches of a colonnade.

title: Redroofed barn - France
text: A countryside scene based on a photograph but extensively changed. Painted in watercolour, with the use of masking fluid for the blossom.
alt: Watercolour of a red-roofed stone barn in France, beside blossoming trees and a field of yellow flowers.

title: Bottles and mugs
alt: Oil painting of bottles and mugs simplified into overlapping flat shapes in cream, blue and brown.

title: Pencil Study of Shells
alt: Pencil drawing of a spiky shell, a sea urchin and smaller shells, in fine grey detail.

title: Summer roses
alt: Watercolour of pink roses and rosebuds with green leaves, on white paper.

title: The two remaining acorns
alt: Watercolour of an oak twig with lobed autumn leaves and two acorns, on white paper.

title: White roses against a blue background
alt: Watercolour of a bunch of white roses, with buds and leaves, against a soft blue background.

title: Shell study on dark background
alt: Watercolour of a ridged shell with long pointed spines, on a dark blue background.

title: Shells on magenta and purple background
alt: Watercolour of a pale shell and a small scallop shell against swirling magenta, purple and gold.

title: Shell design in black ink
alt: Black ink design of a spiral shell surrounded by marbled, flowing patterns.

title: Shell in the clouds
alt: Ink and wash drawing of a spiky shell above clouds, with bands of light radiating in rust, black and white.

title: Steph's Shell
alt: Watercolour and pencil study of a large white shell on a bright red background.

title: Five trees in autumn
alt: Oil painting of five slender trees with yellowing autumn leaves at the edge of a green field.

title: Autumn abundance
alt: Tall, narrow oil painting of conkers in split husks, blackberries and acorns among autumn oak leaves.

title: Lavender field near Petersfield
alt: Painting of rows of purple lavender near Petersfield, Hampshire, stretching towards trees and fields.

title: Tree in the snow
alt: Oil painting of a single bare tree standing in a snowy field under a pale sky.

title: Portrait of a lady
alt: Painted portrait of an older woman with white hair and a purple scarf, hands clasped, against a deep blue background.

title: I expect
alt: Illustrated poem: 'I expect to pass through this world but once', attributed to Etienne de Grellet, hand-lettered within a decorative border.

title: Sonnet 18
alt: Illustrated poem: Shakespeare's Sonnet 18, hand-lettered within a border of pink wild roses and leaves.

title: The Lake Isle of Innisfree
alt: Illustrated poem: W. B. Yeats's 'The Lake Isle of Innisfree', hand-lettered above a lakeside scene with trees, a small cottage and foxgloves.

title: Tyger, Tyger
alt: Illustrated poem: the words of William Blake's 'The Tyger', hand-lettered across a painting of a tiger's face against a starry night sky.
